label: HOSTED_GPT_OSS_SHARED_START_DEVELOPMENT
label_note: Legacy runner allowlisted family label only; actual requested and returned model are separately recorded. GPT55 is explicitly configured, never fallback.

stagnation.policy: Detection/reporting always enabled. Stopping disabled by default; maximum candidate attempts unchanged.

config.source_grounding: Original source plus ontology/representation only; model judgments remain interpretations
config.candidate_attempt_definition: Initial generation plus every code revision. Reviewer format retries are separate.

provider_capabilities.verification: Hosted baseline bounded JSON; provider schema enforcement is unverified. Runtime validates full final response. No reasoning/temperature settings added.

token_limits.provider_limit_evidence: GET /v1/models confirmed model identity but did not expose limits or template; full provider framing/limit unknown
token_limits.count_contract: Verified o200k_harmony encoding of every supplied text block. Full provider-added framing is not exposed; text count is a lower bound, not proof of exact complete input count.

final_review: Existing deterministic handoff; no added model call or repair
shared_start: ONE fresh generation; exact raw response and candidate bytes preserved as Single-shot and supplied to NLTL within this model only.
evaluation_policy: Independent unchanged inputs and counterparts after ALL experiment provider dispatch closes. Ordinary behavior, approval, scope, coverage and strict attribution reported separately. No external score selection.
per_requirement_timeout_note: Existing transport 600-second dispatch window and min(180, remaining) HTTP timeout; local checks/finalization may add overhead. No hard process kill of artifact writes.
